summary: Planet-specific retrograde metadata and plain-language meanings for planets that station retrograde.
body: Retrograde interpretation should stay planet-specific and should distinguish a natal retrograde signature from a temporary transit retrograde period.
definition: A retrograde is apparent backward motion from the observer perspective, used symbolically as review, return, delay, reversal, or internalization depending on planet and context.
appUsage: Do not mark the Sun or Moon retrograde.
Use planet-specific meanings instead of one generic retrograde paragraph.
For daily transit UI, show pre-shadow and post-shadow only when the app has reliable date data.
note: Imported from the project policy bundle; source file was not copied into the repo.

mercury-retrograde.plainTranslation: review of thinking, plans, and messages; recheck details and communications

venus-retrograde.plainTranslation: review of values, money, and relationships; revisit rather than initiate

mars-retrograde.plainTranslation: review of drive and how energy is spent; effort turns inward, frustration possible

jupiter-retrograde.plainTranslation: review of beliefs and where growth is sought; inner expansion over outer

saturn-retrograde.plainTranslation: review of commitments and structures; tighten or release responsibilities

uranus-retrograde.plainTranslation: review of where change and freedom are needed; internal restlessness

neptune-retrograde.plainTranslation: review of ideals and illusions; clearer sight on what was fogged

pluto-retrograde.plainTranslation: review of power and control; transformation works beneath the surface

chiron-retrograde.plainTranslation: review of old wounds, repair, and the survival responses built around them
